title: Our Forefathers Built This; We as Sons Must Preserve This!

sense.text:
Marriage is a fortress, and the house is marriage. “Except the Lord build the house, they labour in vain that build it”: if you are building a house, the Lord has got to be in it. You are trying to build a house without God, and it does not work like that.

“except the Lord keep the city, the watchman waketh but in vain.” Marriage in this truth is built as that fortress, with the counsel of leadership around it on the brothers' side and the sisters' side. A fortress is there to defend and protect you from anything outside that is going to corrupt your marriage. The counsel is not there to hinder anybody from getting married: a family builds a nation, so why would we try to hinder that?

That is why the brothers who are married in this truth were getting counsel all the way up to the wedding day and are still getting it to this day, and the same with the sisters. It never stops. It is a community thing: we are a community, a family, a nation, and community is common unity, everybody thinking the same.

Our people in the 1940s, without knowing they were Israelites, had enough morality to do these things. Marriages were announced from the pulpit for weeks, and that is a betrothal, the same as we do now when the families and leadership give their blessing. The elders pulled the young man aside and showed him how to provide for a family, and the older women taught the young woman how to keep a house, which is Titus 2. It was biblical and they did not even know it. What IUIC is doing is bringing it back.

We know what you are going through. The men in leadership are men; they have all wanted sex. But once you enter into this truth, the woman you are with is to be your wife, and the Bible says to take her to wife before the sex, not after. The counsel is so you don't make the mistakes we made.

“It is vain for you to rise up early, to sit up late, to eat the bread of sorrows”. Why would you wake up in the middle of the night in sorrow? Regret, because of who you married, because you did not have the Lord building your house. You said, I'mma build it myself, I don't need God. That is what all of us did before we came into the truth, and it was only by the grace of the Lord that he woke us up into the truth so we can start to fix the mistakes we were making.

Even in leadership, marriages were on their way to divorce in the world, corrupted by worldly family members, worldly friends, worldly ambitions and worldly lust, and would not have lasted if it were not for this truth. Fathers at 19, kids playing basketball with no means of income, asking their mothers for diapers: that is why when we tell young men to slow down and prove a friend, it is so you do not make the mistakes we made.

Take a father out of the picture for fifteen years and see what it does. Some of these women never had their father in their life; now they come into the truth, get spiritual fathers, and rebel against it, because in the world they never had to listen to a man.

If the Lord is not in it to build the house, if you do not use the Lord's way of building it, you labour in vain and you will eat the bread of sorrows, and you will not get good sleep because of stress, problems and issues. It is when the Lord builds the house that “he giveth his beloved sleep.” But a couple that does it the Lord's way is wrapped in a network of support for life, as long as they keep the commandments: leadership and the brothers have helped families through financial struggles and hard times, because they see the diligence and the work.

“If thou wouldest get a friend, prove him first, and be not hasty to credit him.” Our people understood that back then: it takes time to really get to know someone and to know their intentions.

In the 1940s, without the wisdom of the scriptures, a young man who wanted a young woman had to court her on her family's porch in plain view of everyone: no dates, no secret meetings, no sneaking around and no physical touch. The father let the window up so he could hear everything, the cousins across the street watched, and there was no way to reach the daughter except through her father. That is how fathers watched over their daughters and proved the young man, to see if he really loved her and his intentions were good.

People think IUIC just wants to control people's lives. No, we are doing it to protect you. Most who come in are grown, and the Bible says not to lord over the flock: the captains, the officers and the Bishop cannot make you do anything, but they can give you fatherly advice, tell you what the word of God says and what they have seen, and you can take it or not. At the end of the day, the Bible says you must prove a friend first to know their true intentions.

“For some man is a friend for his own occasion, and will not abide in the day of thy trouble.” Translated: some just want to have sex, and we have them amongst us. Some women just want to have sex, and we have them amongst us too.

We know what men and women want. A man looking across the room is not wondering what her cornbread tastes like or whether she can help him with his resume; he is thinking about the curves, the lips, the body, the face, how she smells. But when you learn the truth you understand that it is more, and that is where the fear of the Lord comes in: there is more than just the outward appearance of a man or a woman.

“Wisdom lifteth up the head of him that is of low degree, and maketh him to sit among great men.” No matter what financial position the brother is in, or if he is just starting a job and working from the bottom, none of that matters: wisdom lifts up his head and will cause him to sit amongst great men.

“Commend not a man for his beauty”. Sisters, the Bible says do not commend a man for his outward appearance. How many of you were deceived by a good-looking man before you came into this truth?

Every woman wants a man; it is natural, and a woman who says she does not want or need a man is going against nature. The woman was taken out of the man, bone of his bone and flesh of his flesh; her body reacts to her husband, and when she is with him all her fear goes out the window and she can rest. We are made in the image of God and she is made in the image of us; she is our glory, which is why the little girls look like their daddy. The woman was made for the man and she cannot do nothing without us. So when a woman says she don't need a man, that's BS, and some of you women in the truth walk around like you do not need your husband. That's BS. You had better release that feminism.

“neither abhor a man for his outward appearance.” A sister would not look at a brother who had his own business, did not work for the white man, spoke several languages, was in the green and booked up through March, because she could not see herself with him, while she could not see herself forty-something and unmarried either. Sit your ass over there in the back then and wait for Prince Charming. These women want a fairy tale, Love & Hip Hop, Disney, and they are missing out on good husbands. Leadership is trying to tell you what good men are: before a brother is ever linked with a sister, we have already grilled him and seen his bank account, because a father would be pissed off to give his daughter to a man with $300 who cannot buy her shoes or pay the light bill.

Every brother is not Boris Kodjoe or Idris Elba. A grandmother who praised how handsome Shemar Moore was in front of the husband who had taken care of her for over forty years was being disrespectful, and that small thing is how women fall into lust and adultery or leave a husband because he does not do it for them anymore.

A sister came into the truth out of the world with a big, buff, soft-spoken brother; he left and she stayed. Years later a diligent brother, an officer, asked about her, but six months into the proving she cried that he was not her type physically. The brother she was attracted to had sex with her and left. They married, the Lord kept blocking them from having kids, and she later confessed to adultery with her boss, who looked just like that first man. She never got over the lust from the world, and her husband divorced her. Kick that hoe to the curb: she belonged to the street, and that is what the Bible says to do. He overcame. Some women commend men for their outward appearance and get jacked up, getting with ungodly men because they look good, or out of lust, or out of fear of being past the age.

A spinster is an unmarried woman beyond the usual age for marriage. When a black woman hits 32, 35, 40, her family starts asking when she is getting married and why she has no kids, and she starts saying the clock is ticking. The world now dresses spinsterhood up as choice and independence, and women in a group all agree they don't need no man, but that is bullcrap. It is a real anxiety for single women, so they say I'll take whatever, any kind of abuse, I'll fornicate, I just need a husband. Then the negro creeps in on that anxiety, they lay together, and then we get what we get. That is why leadership set up the Ladies in Waiting, and the keyword is wait, even six, seven, eight years, because there are things within you the Lord knows you are not ready for, and Men of Valor for the brothers. Then they meet at the end: a proven, diligent brother with a good track record, and a sister with a good name who did everything asked of her. They prove, they court, they have a wedding feast, and the children follow. You will still go through trouble in the flesh, as every marriage does, but because you did it the right way, God is with you.

“Bring not every man into thine house: for the deceitful man hath many trains.” The things our forefathers did in the 1940s were scripture, and they did it off instinct and morality without even knowing it.

From Sirach 6 all the way to Sirach 15 the chapters connect, from proving a friend to not letting just anyone stroll up into your house. The whole thing is saying you have to prove a person. You cannot know somebody in three months, or even in a year. If they are 27 or 30, that is 26 years of them you do not know: their family history, whether mental issues or diabetes run in their family, whether they have an STD.

Yet people jump the gun, do not listen to leadership, and when it does not work they call leadership the devil. The instructions come from the Bible and have a proven track record with hundreds of couples. You would listen to a coach with a winning record; IUIC's leadership has that record and that experience, so why not listen? So for those thinking of leaving Ladies in Waiting or Men of Valor, or of jumping the gun in proving: don't do it. Reconsider.

precepts.why:
Sirach 11:29 and Sirach 6 were read back and forth, verse against verse, to show they say the same thing.

“For some man is a friend for his own occasion, and will not abide in the day of thy trouble.” That is the deceitful man with many trains, the one you must not bring into your house.

“And there is a friend, who being turned to enmity and strife will discover thy reproach.” Bring not every man into thine house.

“Again, some friend is a companion at the table, and will not continue in the day of thy affliction.” Bring not every man into thine house, for the deceitful man hath many trains. That is why you prove a friend first: the one who wants in for his own occasion, who will turn and expose your shame, who sits at your table but leaves in the day of affliction, is exactly the man who should not be brought into your house.
